PR commit message:

```
A Responses API response with status "incomplete" always became
StopReason::MaxTokens, even when it was cut short by the content filter.
Read incomplete_details.reason for the stop reason of both the
non-streaming response and the response.incomplete stream event.

Co-authored-by: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
```
